game.title: Terra Factory
screen.newGame.title: New game
screen.loadGame.title: Load game
screen.settings.title: Settings
screen.newGame.name: Game name
screen.loadGame.pick: Choose a game on the left, then the save to resume on the right.
settings.resetAll.confirm: Reset ALL settings to their defaults?
settings.sound.note: Real sounds come later: the "Test" button plays a beep at the chosen volume.
settings.controls.note: Click a key, then press the new one (Esc to cancel). For a combination, hold a first key then press the second (2 keys maximum, e.g. Ctrl + C; the mouse wheel and buttons count too). Two slots per action.
set.sound.muteInBackground: Mute when the tab is inactive
set.views.top.autoHideFloors: Hide upper floors and roofs inside buildings
modal.controlsLoss.title: Lose your custom keys?
modal.controlsLoss.body: You have changed some keys. This replaces them with the default keys for the {preset} keyboard: your changes will be lost.
modal.resetAll.title: Reset everything?
screen.newGame.seedHelp: Same seed + same settings = same world for every player.
pause.title: Paused
pause.quit.hint: Autosaves, then returns to the main menu
pause.save.title: Save the game
pause.save.name: Save name
pause.save.new: A new save will be created next to the others.
pause.save.overwrite: A save already has this name: it will be replaced.
modal.deleteGame.title: Delete this game?
modal.deleteGame.body: "{name}" and its {n} save(s) will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
hint.mouseLook: Click to capture the mouse (Esc to release)
editor.hint.forests: Frequency: number of groves · Size: extent · Density: trees per grove
editor.hint.rocks: Frequency: number of outcrops · Size: extent · Density: rocks per outcrop
editor.hint.ores: Frequency: number of deposits · Size: extent of each pile · Density: ore per cell
editor.hint.water: Frequency: number of ponds · Size: surface · Density: chance of a pond per area
editor.hint.enemies: Frequency: number of nests · Size: starting colony size · Density: chance of a nest per area
editor.enemies.aggressive.help: They attack the player and their installations. Off by default.
editor.enemies.expand.help: They grow (faster with pollution) and found new nests. On by default.
editor.realism.help: Heat, pressure, electricity… Will apply once these systems are in the game.
editor.preview.title: World preview (top view)
editor.preview.note: 320 m square around the starting point. The white circle marks the guaranteed start area (150 m).
inv.title: Bag
inv.hint: Right-click a stack: take half onto the cursor; Ctrl + click: choose the amount. Click a machine or chest slot to drop it, or the bag to put it back. Dropped items land in front of you. Hold Interact on them to pick them up.
manage.renameGame.title: Rename the game
manage.renameSlot.title: Rename the save
manage.name: New name
manage.nameTaken: Another save already has this name.
import.error.title: Import failed
import.error.invalid: This file is not a readable Terra Factory game.
import.error.format: This file is not a Terra Factory game.
import.error.newer: This file comes from a newer version of the game. Update the game to open it.
import.error.tooBig: The file is too big to be a game.
modal.deleteSlot.title: Delete this save?
modal.deleteSlot.body: "{name}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
storage.memory: Warning: this browser cannot keep your games (private browsing?). Export them to a file so you do not lose them.
storage.localstorage: Main storage is unavailable: games are kept in a limited fallback space.
storage.failed: A save could not be written (disk full?). Export your game to a file to be safe.
build.title: Building
build.help: R: lock / rotate 90° · PgUp/PgDn: floor · Home/End: wall height (top view) · Hold click: area or wall · Hold X: demolish · same slot: put away
build.missing: Item not in the bag: craft it in the inventory
build.inRoom: You are inside a closed room
inv.craftHint: Left click: craft 1 · Right click: craft 5
inv.raw: Raw resource: it is gathered, not crafted.
inv.selectHint: Click a slot to select it and drop its contents.
build.unsupported: A wall cannot float: place it on the ground or against an existing wall
build.wallHeight: Wall height in top view: {n} block(s) ({cm} cm)
build.unsupportedCeiling: A ceiling attaches to the top of walls: place it against a wall or extend a slab (3 cells max from a wall)
hotbar.hint: Shortcut bar: drag an item from the bag onto a slot, or select it in the bag then click a slot. Right-click a slot to empty it.
build.unsupportedStairs: Stairs go on the ground, on a floor slab, or continue another flight upward
factory.needOre: A drill must be placed on ore
factory.helpMachine: R: orient the output · click: place · same slot: put away
factory.helpConveyor: R: direction · hold click and trace to place several belts in a row · same slot: put away
machine.dragHint: Drag an item from the bag onto a machine slot (or click the item, then the slot). Drag a machine slot onto the bag to take it back.
harvest.structureUse: Left click: open · hold right click: demolish
machine.chestHint: Drag an item from the bag into the chest; click a chest slot (or drag it onto the bag) to take it back.
harvest.doorUse: Left click: open / close · hold right click: demolish
factory.power.none: not connected: place a pole within {m} m
factory.power.pole: Grid: {n} machine(s) · production {cap} kW · demand {demand} kW
factory.router.splitter: Splits one belt into 3 outputs (front, left, right), in turn.
factory.router.merger: Merges up to 3 belts (back, left, right) into the front output.
inv.pickInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
factory.router.arm: Picks items from 3 sides (back, left, right: belt, chest, machine) and drops them in front. It burns fuel and refuels itself from nearby containers when running low.
map.title: Map
map.help: Drag to pan, mouse wheel or + / − to zoom, M or Esc to close. Distant areas appear progressively.
factory.router.arm_electric: Like the fuel arm but powered through a pole (20 kW): twice as fast. Picks from 3 sides (back, left, right) and drops in front.
factory.router.assembler: Crafts the chosen item from ingredients brought by belts or arms (any side except the front output). Electric: 60 kW.
machine.ingHint: Drag or click an ingredient from the bag onto its slot. Click the slot to take it back.
factory.arm.diag.ok: Ready: an item can be picked.
factory.arm.diag.noDest: Nothing in front: place a machine, belt or chest in front.
factory.arm.diag.noSource: Nothing to pick behind, left or right.
factory.arm.diag.refused: Items are nearby but the destination refuses them (e.g. fuel through the output face of a furnace or drill; ore: furnace already full of another ore; an item that cannot be smelted).
factory.block.nothing: End of belt: {item} has nowhere to go (nothing in front).
factory.block.waiting: Just a moment, the cell in front is clearing.
factory.refuse.merger: a merger pulls from belts that touch it itself — connect it with a belt pointing at it
factory.refuse.facing: the next belt faces this one
factory.refuse.otherOre: the furnace already holds another ore (one type at a time)
factory.refuse.notUsable: it has no use for this item
factory.refuse.fuelFull: the fuel slot is full or holds another type
factory.refuse.ingredientFull: enough of this ingredient is waiting
factory.refuse.notIngredient: not an ingredient of the recipe
equip.title: Equipment
equip.head: Head
equip.hint: Drag or click equipment from the bag onto its slot. Click a filled slot to take it off.
equip.bagFull: Cannot remove it: the bag would be too full without it.
tech.title: Technologies
tech.missing: Not enough resources in the bag
tech.help: The cost is taken from the bag. T or Esc to close.
